CustomField.description: API name of the Screen Flow this section embeds when Component Type is Flow. Passed to c-flow-form-screen-flow as flow-api-name. The page section editor's Flow picklist lists only active flows built from the (Form) Flow Section template (FormPageSectionConfigurator_Controller.getFlowSectionTemplates), which carry the record/recordId/navigation-button input-output contract the form runtime exchanges; flows built from scratch will not appear but a previously saved value is still shown.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Active flows built from the Form Flow Section template. Select the Screen Flow to embed in this section; it must be Active and created from that template so it exchanges the form's record and navigation data.
CustomField.label: FlowApiName
